description: Qloo tag URNs pinned at build time from GET /v2/tags (call Q16). Runtime code reads tag IDs only from this file; a tag whose status is not "pinned" is skipped and the card says so. See config/README.md.

validation.anchor: Hampton Coliseum, Hampton VA (Ticketmaster venue coordinates)
validation.baselineAnchor: A hero room (Ticketmaster venue coordinates), 40 km

categories.label: Irish pub
categories.note: Dropped Oct 15: 1 row within 25 km of the anchor (5 needed).

categories.label: Restaurant
categories.note: Also the generic heatmap baseline signal for Q6. No category:place restaurant tag came back; this is the canonical genre:place tag.

categories.label: Record store
categories.note: Dropped Oct 15: 2 rows within 25 km of the anchor (5 needed). Partner cards say it was skipped. Re-validate at another hero room before using it.

categories.label: Barber shop
categories.note: Kept only if validation returns enough rows (it did: 10 of 10 carry the tag).

categories.label: Beauty salon
categories.note: Kept only if validation returns enough rows (it did: 10 of 10 carry the tag).

categories.label: Night club
categories.note: Exclusion only: sent as filter.exclude.tags when the show is not 21+ (Ticketmaster ageRestrictions).

categories.label: Place of worship
categories.note: Dropped Oct 15: found only through the query "church" (the words "place of worship" are not in the tag name) and 4 rows within 25 km (5 needed). Only to help an operator pick a congregation they declared themselves; never used to discover or rank places on its own.

categories.label: Soul food
categories.note: Cuisine tag. Added to the partner category set only when the operator selects it.

baselines.label: Country fans in general
baselines.note: Genre-tag baseline for a music bill whose roster house resolves fewer than 5 acts. Pinned only when a heatmap with this tag as the only signal returns at least validation.baselineMinCells cells near a hero room. validatedRows holds that cell count.

sponsorExclusions.label: Alcohol
sponsorExclusions.note: Sponsor exclusion on shows that are not 21+. Dropped Oct 15: the /v2/tags lookup for "alcohol" on brands returned no candidate. Until one is pinned, the sponsor card relies on its own name and tag filter for adult-only brands.

sponsorExclusions.label: Tobacco
sponsorExclusions.note: Sponsor exclusion on shows that are not 21+.

sponsorExclusions.label: Gambling
sponsorExclusions.note: Sponsor exclusion on shows that are not 21+.

personChecks.label: Comedian
personChecks.note: A person on a comedy bill is admissible as a seed only if it carries this tag. Pin whichever candidate the API confirms.
